description: This source file contains extension methods for VoiceWakeOverlayController, implementing UI presentation logic for a voice wake overlay controller, including window management, view presentation, sizing, and positioning.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Handles presentation of the voice wake overlay window, including creating the window if needed, setting up the view, and presenting the overlay panel.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures the overlay window and hosting view if they do not already exist.

methods.name: bringToFrontIfVisible
methods.description: Brings the overlay window to front if it is visible.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the target frame for positioning the overlay window.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the overlay window's frame, optionally with animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the height of the overlay based on its content.

methods.name: dismissTargetFrame
methods.description: Calculates a target frame for dismissing the overlay, based on the reason and outcome.
